parties: President of India (Ministry of Railways, Government of India); Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited; NSE
headline: Government of India offers up to 13.07 crore equity shares of IRFC via stock exchange OFS mechanism
sum: The President of India, through the Ministry of Railways, announced an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 13,06,85,060 equity shares of Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited (IRFC) via NSE stock exchange mechanism. The OFS opened for non-retail investors on 24 Jun 2026 and retail investors on 25 Jun 2026, representing a government disinvestment in the PSU.
detail: IRFC, a wholly government-owned financial services PSU under Ministry of Railways, offered equity shares of face value ₹10 each through a two-tranche OFS. Non-retail investors (institutional and qualified entities) could bid on 24 Jun 2026 (9:15 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.), followed by retail investors on 25 Jun 2026 (opening 9:15 a.m.). The offer was conducted on NSE under the stock exchange OFS mechanism, enabling the government to divest a tranche of its holding without appointing merchant bankers for a traditional IPO-style process.
